description: This file defines the IErrorGrain interface, which extends ISimpleGrain and declares asynchronous methods related to error handling, delayed execution, and managing child grains, used in unit tests within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: IErrorGrain
classes.description: Interface for error-related operations in grains for unit testing, includes methods for logging, setting errors, retrieving error states, simulating delays, and managing child grains.

methods.name: SetAError
methods.description: Sets an error with an integer value for A.

methods.name: SetBError
methods.description: Sets an error with an integer value for B.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Retrieves an integer representing the combined error state for A and B.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Retrieves an integer error state for A and B with parameters.

methods.name: LongMethod
methods.description: Simulates a long-running operation with a specified wait time.

methods.name: LongMethodWithError
methods.description: Simulates a long-running operation that may produce an error.

methods.name: DelayMethod
methods.description: Delays for the specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorImmediate
methods.description: Returns an error code immediately, potentially triggering an unobserved exception.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorDelayed
methods.description: Returns an error code after a delay, testing unobserved exception handling.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation2
methods.description: Returns an error code with continuation, testing unobserved exceptions.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation3
methods.description: Returns an error code with a different continuation, for unobserved exception testing.

methods.name: UnobservedIgnoredError
methods.description: Returns an error code that is ignored, testing unobserved errors.

methods.name: AddChildren
methods.description: Adds a list of child IErrorGrain instances asynchronously.

methods.name: ExecuteDelayed
methods.description: Executes a delay asynchronously, returning a success boolean.
